description: Replace Google OAuth with a self-hosted email+password auth system with email verification, backed by Neon and Auth.js v5 Credentials. Users REGISTER with email+password; a confirmation email (Resend) with a verification token is sent; the account must be verified before it can sign in. Passwords hashed with bcryptjs. Sessions via Auth.js v5 JWT strategy + a Credentials provider (chosen for minimal moving parts on Vercel+Neon: JWT keeps the no-env build + lazy-config invariant and avoids a DB session adapter; user identity/role/verified come from Neon at sign-in and are carried in the signed JWT via AUTH_SECRET). Default role for a self-registered user = STUDENT (test-taker). The ADMIN assigns elevated roles. Add a PROFESOR staff role so the role set is Admin(SUPER_ADMIN)/Tester(TEST_ADMIN)/Profesor(PROFESOR)/Revisor de resultados(REPORT_REVIEWER)/Estudiante(STUDENT). Seed an initial pre-verified admin (bcrypt-hashed password) via db:seed. All user-facing text in Spanish.
steps: Add deps in web/: npm install bcryptjs and npm install -D @types/bcryptjs. (resend is added in FEAT-003; if convenient add it here too.) Keep Auth.js v5 (next-auth@beta already present); remove the next-auth/providers/google usage.

Schema (web/db/schema.sql): extend app_users so it stores credentials auth. Add columns idempotently (ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS): password_hash TEXT, email_verified_at BIGINT (nullable; NULL = unverified). Ensure a UNIQUE index on lower(email) (CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_app_users_email_lower ON app_users (lower(email))). Change/limit auth_provider usage to 'EMAIL' for credentials users (keep column, default 'EMAIL'). Add a new table email_verification_tokens (token TEXT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL, purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VERIFY_EMAIL', created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, consumed_at BIGINT) with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and an index on email. All statements idempotent.

Update web/lib/riasec/types.ts: add PROFESOR to UserRoleCode and USER_ROLES (title 'Profesor', isStaff true, Spanish description e.g. orientation/teaching staff who can review student results of their groups). Keep SUPER_ADMIN/TEST_ADMIN/REPORT_REVIEWER/STUDENT. Set STUDENT as the default self-registration role. AuthProviderCode default becomes 'EMAIL'.
Create web/lib/auth/passwords.ts: hashPassword(plain) and verifyPassword(plain, hash) using bcryptjs (cost ~10). Pure, no env read at import.

Create web/lib/auth/tokens.ts: generateVerificationToken() (crypto.randomUUID or randomBytes hex), createVerificationToken(email) that inserts a row in email_verification_tokens with an expiry (e.g. 24h) via lazy query, and consumeVerificationToken(token) that validates not-expired/not-consumed, marks consumed_at, and returns the email (or null). Runtime-only (uses lib/db.ts).

Create web/lib/auth/users.ts: DB-backed user helpers using lib/db.ts: findUserByEmail(email) (case-insensitive), createUser({email, displayName, passwordHash, role='STUDENT'}) with ON CONFLICT on lower(email) DO NOTHING returning inserted-or-null, markEmailVerified(email), getUserRole(email). These replace the env-allowlist role resolution.

Rewrite web/lib/auth/roles.ts: remove resolveRoleForEmail's env-allowlist + DEFAULT_USERS logic. Keep isStaffRole(role) (now includes PROFESOR via USER_ROLES). Provide a DB-backed role lookup (delegate to lib/auth/users.getUserRole) used at sign-in. Keep the module pure at import (no env/DB at load).

Rewrite web/auth.ts: NextAuth v5 with a Credentials provider (email + password). authorize(): find user by email (Neon); if not found or password mismatch (bcrypt verifyPassword) return null; if email_verified_at is null, reject sign-in (return null / throw a Spanish 'cuenta no verificada' error surfaced to the login UI). On success return {id,email,role}. session strategy 'jwt'; secret = process.env.AUTH_SECRET read per request. jwt callback puts role on token; session callback exposes session.user.role. isAuthConfigured() now returns true only when AUTH_SECRET is set (DB presence checked lazily); if AUTH_SECRET is unset the app reports 'auth no configurada' at runtime but build still passes. Remove the Google provider and events.signIn OAuth linking (link-user.ts can be deleted or repurposed; if deleted, remove its import).

Update web/lib/auth/session.ts: keep getCurrentUser()/requireRole()/requireStaff() shape but update Spanish messages to reference 'iniciar sesion con tu correo y contrasena' instead of Google. getCurrentUser reads auth() session as before.

Update web/lib/auth/staff.ts: keep authorizeStaffWithRoles/authorizeStaff and the STAFF_ACCESS_TOKEN legacy fallback behavior (still valid when AUTH_SECRET unset), but update Spanish wording that referenced OAuth/Google to credentials. isStaffAuthEnabled() gated on !isAuthConfigured() as before.
Update web/lib/auth/read-access.ts: update Spanish messages that mention Google to 'iniciar sesion' generically. Logic (owner-by-email + staff) unchanged.

Replace web/lib/actions/auth.ts server actions: remove signInWithGoogle/signOutAction-with-google. Add: registerAction({email, displayName, password}) -> validates (email format, password min length e.g. 8), hashes password, createUser (role STUDENT, unverified), createVerificationToken, sends confirmation email via the email module (FEAT-003 provides sendVerificationEmail; if FEAT-003 not yet merged, call a lib/email placeholder created here), returns Spanish success/duplicate/error result. loginAction({email,password}) -> signIn('credentials', ...) mapping Auth.js errors to Spanish (invalid creds / unverified account). verifyEmailAction(token) or a route to consume token + markEmailVerified. logoutAction -> signOut({redirectTo:'/'}). All read secrets lazily.

Create pages/UI (Spanish): web/app/register/page.tsx (form: nombre, correo, contrasena -> registerAction, shows 'Revisa tu correo para confirmar tu cuenta'), web/app/login/page.tsx (form: correo, contrasena -> loginAction, shows verification-required message when applicable), web/app/verify/page.tsx (reads ?token=, calls verifyEmailAction, shows success/expired). Replace web/components/AuthControls.tsx and SignInButton.tsx to show Registrarse/Iniciar sesion when logged out and the user email + Cerrar sesion when logged in (using the new actions). Remove Google-specific UI. Keep StaffTokenField/useStaffToken only as the legacy no-auth fallback (leave functioning when AUTH_SECRET unset).
Keep web/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts re-exporting { GET, POST } from web/auth.ts (Credentials provider still uses the NextAuth handler).

Seed initial admin: extend web/data/seed.ts and web/scripts/seed.ts. Add a seedAdmin() step that upserts one admin into app_users: email admin@orientapp.local, display name 'Administrador OrientApp', role SUPER_ADMIN, auth_provider 'EMAIL', email_verified_at = now (pre-verified), password_hash = bcrypt hash of the default password OrientApp!Admin2026. Allow override via env INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL / INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD (defaults to the documented pair). Hash at seed time (NEVER store plaintext). Use ON CONFLICT (lower(email)) DO NOTHING (idempotent). Reads DATABASE_URL lazily; if unset, keep the existing Spanish exit. Update DEFAULT_USERS to drop the Google-provider seed users OR mark them EMAIL/unverified so they cannot log in without a password (prefer removing the fictional Google users and keeping only the real admin to avoid confusion); keep DEFAULT_COHORTS.

Update web/.env.example: REMOVE GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAILS/TEST_ADMIN_EMAILS/REPORT_REVIEWER_EMAILS, AUTH_URL/NEXTAUTH_URL commentary specific to Google, and all AI_*/embedding vars. KEEP/ADD AUTH_SECRET (required to enable auth; openssl rand -base64 32) with Spanish comment, keep DATABASE_URL, keep NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, keep STAFF_ACCESS_TOKEN (legacy fallback note updated). Add INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL / INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD (optional overrides for the seeded admin) with Spanish comments. (RESEND_API_KEY/EMAIL_FROM added in FEAT-003.)

Tests (Vitest, real assertions, mock DB/Resend where needed): web/tests/passwords.test.ts (hash != plaintext; verify true for correct, false for wrong). web/tests/tokens.test.ts (token lifecycle: create->consume once succeeds, second consume fails, expired token fails) mocking lib/db. web/tests/auth-credentials.test.ts (authorize rejects unknown user, wrong password, and unverified account; accepts verified with correct password) mocking users/passwords. Update web/tests/auth-roles.test.ts to the new DB-backed role model + PROFESOR (isStaffRole(PROFESOR)===true; STUDENT default). Keep read-access tests meaningful. Ensure the whole suite stays green.
Run verification: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test -- --run, and the no-env build (also unset RESEND_API_KEY).
acceptance_criteria: Google OAuth is fully removed: no next-auth/providers/google import, no GOOGLE_* env in .env.example, no Google-specific UI; app is not left with both OAuth and credentials wired.
A user can register (email+password); password is stored only as a bcrypt hash in app_users; a verification token row is created and a confirmation email send is invoked (mocked in tests).
Sign-in is rejected for an unverified account and for wrong credentials, and succeeds for a verified account with correct password (covered by auth-credentials.test.ts).
Verification token lifecycle is single-use and expiry-aware (covered by tokens.test.ts).
Default self-registration role is STUDENT; PROFESOR exists as a staff role; USER_ROLES has Admin/Tester/Profesor/Revisor/Estudiante with Spanish titles; isStaffRole covers all staff roles.

npm run db:seed (dry, code path) upserts the admin admin@orientapp.local pre-verified with a bcrypt hash of OrientApp!Admin2026 (or env overrides), idempotently, and exits in Spanish when DATABASE_URL is unset. No plaintext password is stored.
Role-based authorization on staff pages/endpoints is preserved via the adapted helpers (staff mutations require staff roles; reviewers/admins per the matrix).

npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test -- --run pass, and env -u DATABASE_URL -u AUTH_SECRET -u RESEND_API_KEY npm run build succeeds (no-env build invariant held; auth reports 'no configurada' at runtime without AUTH_SECRET).
verification: cd web && env -u DATABASE_URL -u AUTH_SECRET -u RESEND_API_KEY npm run build
grep -rE 'providers/google|GOOGLE_CLIENT|signInWithGoogle' web/app web/lib web/components (expect no matches)
grep -n 'OrientApp!Admin2026' web/data/seed.ts web/scripts/seed.ts (default present; ensure it is only used to compute a bcrypt hash, never stored raw)
findings: Replaced Google OAuth with email+password Credentials auth fully. 30 files changed. Key decisions implemented: (1) bcryptjs installed (pure-JS). (2) auth.ts rewritten with Credentials provider; isAuthConfigured() now only checks AUTH_SECRET. (3) Removed link-user.ts (Google OAuth linking), providers/google. (4) PROFESOR role added to UserRoleCode/USER_ROLES with isStaff:true. (5) lib/auth/roles.ts: removed env-allowlist resolveRoleForEmail; added isStaffRole (pure) + resolveRoleFromDB (lazy). (6) DB schema extended: password_hash, email_verified_at, UNIQUE INDEX on lower(email), email_verification_tokens table. (7) New lib/auth/passwords.ts, tokens.ts, users.ts. (8) New lib/email/client.ts stub (logs when RESEND_API_KEY unset; ready for FEAT-003). (9) New server actions: registerAction, loginAction, verifyEmailAction, logoutAction. (10) New pages: /register, /login, /verify. (11) seedAdmin() in scripts/seed.ts upserts admin@orientapp.local with bcrypt hash of OrientApp!Admin2026. (12) DEFAULT_USERS emptied (fictional Google users removed). (13) .env.example cleaned: removed GOOGLE_*, AI_*, ADMIN_EMAILS allowlists; added AUTH_SECRET, INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD. (14) Test files: auth-roles, read-access, read-access-routes updated to remove Google mocks; 3 new test files (passwords, tokens, auth-credentials). (15) 132 tests green, typecheck OK, lint OK, no-env build OK. Minor note: tokens.test.ts mock needed params count fix (purpose is hardcoded in SQL, not a param).
